descriptions.d15b_blend_toward_input_800abc18: Clamp an input to plus or minus the controller range scalar, map it to (input / range + 1) * 0.5, move the blend value toward that target by the rate scalar and clamp the blend to [0, 1], using const-reference min/max selections. Scalars read through the original accessor; float constants referenced by address; partial layout; no owned initialized data.
